# ColinMichaels.com

> The personal site of Colin Michaels, a Florida-based applications developer, FPV drone pilot, creative technologist, and writer publishing Angular/Firebase architecture notes, practical AI workflow guides, media projects, interactive experiments, gadget writing, and patient-perspective recovery notes.

This is a curated index for AI tools and readers. It supplements the canonical HTML pages, `robots.txt`, sitemap, and feeds; it does not define crawler permissions or content licensing. When citing an article, prefer its canonical URL, page title, author, and on-page publication or update date. Health and recovery content describes personal experience and is not medical, legal, insurance, or financial advice.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://colinmichaels.com/): Overview of Colin Michaels, current featured writing, projects, media, and topic guides.
- [Blog](https://colinmichaels.com/blog): Published articles and recent writing across technology, creative projects, and recovery.

## Topic guides

- [AI Setup Guides](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/ai-setup): Practical guides for ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, prompting, projects, and AI-assisted workflows.
- [Recovery and Medical Planning Resources](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/recovery-planning): Personal recovery notes, emergency-planning resources, and lessons from open-heart surgery recovery.
- [Angular and Firebase Architecture Notes](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/angular-firebase-architecture): Implementation notes on Angular, Firebase, CMS workflows, route SEO, and reusable frontend architecture.
- [Labs and Project Demos](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/labs-projects): Interactive demos, browser experiments, UI systems, and public project notes.
- [Gadgets and Toys](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/gadgets-toys): Hands-on reviews, wish-list notes, and interesting gadgets, toys, and technology found online.

## Feeds and discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://colinmichaels.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of public pages, topic guides, published posts, and qualifying taxonomy archives.
- [RSS feed](https://colinmichaels.com/feed.xml): Recent published articles in RSS format.
- [JSON feed](https://colinmichaels.com/feed.json): Recent published articles in JSON Feed format.

## Optional

- [How to Set Up ChatGPT for Better AI Chats](https://colinmichaels.com/blog/how-to-set-up-chatgpt-for-better-ai-chats): A practical guide to model choice, instructions, projects, tools, research, and agent workflows.
- [How to Set Up Claude for Better AI Chats](https://colinmichaels.com/blog/how-to-set-up-claude-for-better-ai-chats): A practical guide to configuring Claude for more useful conversations and project work.
- [How to Set Up Copilot for Better AI Chats](https://colinmichaels.com/blog/how-to-set-up-copilot-for-better-ai-chats): A practical guide to configuring Copilot for more useful conversations and workflows.
- [How to Set Up Gemini for Better AI Chats](https://colinmichaels.com/blog/how-to-set-up-gemini-for-better-ai-chats): A practical guide to configuring Gemini for more useful conversations and workflows.
- [The Emergency Plan Nobody Thinks They Need](https://colinmichaels.com/blog/emergency-plan-nobody-thinks-they-need): A patient-perspective emergency-planning article.
- [Florida Medical Planning Guide](https://colinmichaels.com/blog/florida-medical-planning-guide): A patient-perspective guide to organizing medical and recovery planning in Florida.
